ledger.note: By 1861-1862: Maba Diakhou Bâ takes Rip and most of Saloum. "By 1861 Maba controlled all of Rip" and "soon controlled most of Saloum and part of Niumi"; in October 1864 "the French recognized him as Almamy of Baddibu and Saloum." The Saloum page has the Maad Saloum fighting on Sine's side against Maba in 1867. The page gives no month; 1862 follows the Maba page's account of his control of most of Saloum after the October 1862 attack on Kaolack.

wars.outcome: Maba controlled Rip by 1861 and most of Saloum by 1862, was recognized by the French as Almamy of Baddibu and Saloum in October 1864, took the Battle of Pathé Badiane near Nioro on 30 November (1865), invaded Sine in 1866 and was defeated and killed at Fandane-Thiouthioune on 18 July 1867.
wars.note: The Saloum page has the Maad Saloum on Sine's side against Maba in 1867; the Maba page has Maba controlling most of Saloum. The two pages are not reconciled here.

notes:
Saloum (Kingdom of Saloum), additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Pages: Kingdom of Saloum, Maba Diakhou Ba.

The jolof-empire dossier (from the Jolof page) has Sine and Saloum absorbed by Jolof in the late 14th century and breaking away in 1520; the Saloum page says Saloum "was never a part of the empire", though its southern and eastern parts were under Jolof's influence. No Saloum event records that, and the conflict is flagged. The Maba page and the Saloum page differ on Maba's relation to Saloum (the first has him ruling most of Saloum from 1861-62, the second has the Maad Saloum on Sine's side in 1867): the contest 1862-1867 is the Maba page's reading, at confidence 2. The Maba page dates only 1861, 1862, May 1864, October 1864, 1866 and 18 July 1867. The 1867 end is the infobox span; the page has no year for the incorporation. The 1785 trade treaty and the 1857 Albreda exchange are on the page and are not border events. Niumi's conquest (Latmenge Dielene) has no year on the page and is not in the ledger.
